EXCERIA PLUS G4

Get an enhanced PC experience with the all-new KIOXIA EXCERIA PLUS G4 SSD series featuring a state-of-the-art PCIe® 5.0 interface. Offering improved performance and up to 2TB of capacity for gamers and video editors, the EXCERIA PLUS G4 series delivers low power consumption and reduced heat generation.

Featuring the latest and greatest PCIe® 5.0 interface, the EXCERIA PLUS G4 SSD series delivers excellent transfer speeds of up to 10,000MB/s for sequential reads and 8,200MB/s for sequential writes. Whether you are loading the latest game or editing the next viral video, this new series will provide the speed you need.

Power Efficiency Prioritized
The EXCERIA PLUS G4 SSD series delivers significantly improved performance without excessive energy or cooling requirements. Designed with efficiency in mind, EXCERIA PLUS G4 SSDs offer low power consumption, reducing the heat generated in your system. These SSDs delivers up to approximately 80% more power efficiency at max sequential read speed over the previous generation EXCERIA PLUS G3 series.

Advanced Heat Dissipation
EXCERIA PLUS G4 SSDs feature innovative product labels to enhance heat dissipation for advanced performance stability.

Cutting-Edge 3D Flash Memory
Each EXCERIA SSD is built with BiCS FLASH™ and a vertically stacked cell structure, delivering a cutting edge storage experience.
